svg.title: Compare named examples
svg.desc: Ifugao Hudhud concerns narrative chanting. Hanunoo and Buhid script traditions in Mindoro concern writing. Both involve learning and transmission; they are not identical or descriptions of every resident.

g.text: Compare named examples, not whole populations
Shared idea: knowledge can be passed on in different forms.
Source summaries, not every community member or every historical period.
